cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your solo debut may proceed once you've asked your understudy for the opening line.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you cue me without telling everyone I forgot it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I authorize a discreet rescue. First, acknowledge that you need me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you. Quietly. They're listening at the curtain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request for discretion is granted. Lean toward me; I shouldn't have to raise my voice to save your opening night.

reason: Use a distinct backstage dependence: the assisting understudy behaves as superior, makes acknowledgment the price of a cue, then answers the performer's actual discretion need after receiving it.
